roadmap.title: Havenport basics and first levels
roadmap.description: Play the main save, learn the Codex, and raise skills to level 20 with early totals and first Log entries.

roadmap.title: Early bosses and Tharion Isles
roadmap.description: Defeat the farm and early-area bosses and begin Beastmastery, Thieving, Tracking and Devotion milestones.

roadmap.title: Homestead and Soulbinding
roadmap.description: Build the Homestead, grow crops, raise Soulbinding and discover souls.

roadmap.title: Mid game level 60 and later bosses
roadmap.description: Raise skills to level 60, clear Forgotten Shore and Hinterlands bosses, and fill skill logs.

roadmap.title: Late grind to level 100
roadmap.description: Reach level 100 in every skill, large bank and coin totals, and the 10,000-count milestones.

roadmap.title: Collection logs and decorations
roadmap.description: Complete Codex logs, Almanac entries, Homestead buildings and decorations.

roadmap.title: Turbo Mode and events
roadmap.description: Turbo Mode save slot 4 achievements, plus Banana and Chocolate Egg event items.

achievements.description: Congratulations, you're now a Bloob!
achievements.summary: Start playing Bloobs Adventure Idle on a main save.

guide.context: Only main saves count. Turbo Mode on save slot 4 does not unlock it.

steps.text: Pick a main save slot and press play. Do not choose @mechanic{Turbo Mode}.

achievements.description: Congratulations, your Bloob is now an Ultimate Woodcutter
achievements.summary: Reach level 100 in Woodcutting.

guide.context: Level 100 needs 14,391,160 XP in total.

steps.text: Keep chopping the highest tree your level allows with your best axe, with a @item{Timber Potion} active.
A golden pop-up on the tree gives 150% XP and an extra log.

achievements.description: Congratulations, your Bloob is now an Ultimate Fisher
achievements.summary: Reach level 100 in Fishing.

guide.context: Level 100 needs 14,391,160 XP in total.

steps.text: Keep fishing the best node your level allows with your best rod, with an @item{Angling Potion} active.
If you have Devotion Points, channel @mechanic{Fisher's Season} for 15% more Fishing XP.

achievements.description: Congratulations, your Bloob is now an Ultimate Forager
achievements.summary: Reach level 100 in Foraging.

guide.context: Level 100 needs 14,391,160 XP in total.

steps.text: Keep gathering the best plant your level allows with your best lens.
A golden pop-up on the plant gives 150% XP and an extra copy.

achievements.description: Congratulations, your Bloob is now an Ultimate Attack Master
achievements.summary: Reach level 100 in Attack.

guide.context: Level 100 needs 14,391,160 XP in total.

steps.text: Keep your best melee weapon and matching melee armour equipped while you fight strong monsters.
Boost accuracy with a @item{Savage Power Potion} (Herbology 74) or the @mechanic{Warrior's Might} invocation (Devotion 98).

achievements.description: Congratulations, your Bloob is now an Ultimate Miner
achievements.summary: Reach level 100 in Mining.

guide.context: Level 100 needs 14,391,160 XP in total.

steps.text: Keep mining the best ore your level allows with your best pickaxe, with an @item{Excavation Potion} active.
A golden pop-up on the ore gives 150% XP and an extra ore.

achievements.description: Congratulations, your Bloob is now an Ultimate Smithing Master
achievements.summary: Reach level 100 in Smithing.

guide.context: Level 100 needs 14,391,160 XP in total.

steps.text: Smelt the best bar your level allows. Cerulium to Phantom bars need @item{Luminous Ore}. From Karinite on, reforge Cores into @item{Ember Core}s at the Incinerated Foundry. They replace secondary ores in bars at level 100 and above.
Smith items from the bars until you reach level 100.

achievements.description: Congratulations, your Bloob is now an Ultimate Cook
achievements.summary: Reach level 100 in Cooking.

guide.context: Level 100 needs 14,391,160 XP in total.

steps.text: Keep cooking the best food your level allows until level 100.

achievements.description: Congratulations, your Bloob is now an Ultimate Firemaker
achievements.summary: Reach level 100 in Firemaking.

guide.context: Level 100 needs 14,391,160 XP in total.

steps.text: Burn the best logs your level allows.
At Herbology level 81, make a @item{Super Firemaker's Potion} from an Emberplume Vial (unfinished) and a Firemaker's Potion, and keep one active while you burn.
Once you have Devotion level 89 and Devotion Points, channel @mechanic{Kindler's Boon} for 15% more Firemaking XP.

achievements.description: Congratulations, your Bloob is now an Ultimate Runner
achievements.summary: Reach level 100 in Dexterity.

guide.context: Level 100 needs 14,391,160 XP in total.

steps.text: Run the best Bloobathon you have the level for. Forgotten Shore opens at level 70, its Extended run at 85, and Hinterland Village at 95.
Wear @item{Run Speed Boots} if you have found a pair, since they speed up each lap.

achievements.description: Congratulations, your Bloob is now an Ultimate Potion Maker
achievements.summary: Reach level 100 in Herbology.

guide.context: Level 100 needs 14,391,160 XP in total, which takes tens of thousands of vials. Stock up on Molten Glass first.

steps.text: Fill vials with water at the @loc{Havenport} well. Mix each water vial with 3 herbs, then add the potion's second ingredient.

Make the newest potion you have unlocked: Fortitude (level 60), Sanctified Grace (71), Savage Power (74), Marksman's Might (77), Wizard's Wisdom (80), Super Swiftness (84), then Super Imbuer's Potion (94) until level 100.

achievements.description: Congratulations, your Bloob is now an Ultimate Crafter
achievements.summary: Reach level 100 in Crafting.

guide.context: Level 100 needs 14,391,160 XP in total.

steps.text: Craft @item{Ruby Necklace}s until level 70, then @item{Diamond Necklace}s until level 88.
Craft @item{Black Diamond Necklace}s from level 88 until you reach level 100.

achievements.description: Congratulations, your Bloob is now an Ultimate BowCrafter
achievements.summary: Reach level 100 in Bowcrafting.

guide.context: Level 100 needs 14,391,160 XP in total. The last ten levels take tens of thousands of crafts.

steps.text: Craft the Unstrung Shortbow for the best logs you can use: @item{Eucalyptus Shortbow U} at level 60, @item{Yew Shortbow U} at 70, @item{Red Maple Shortbow U} at 80, then @item{Magic Shortbow U} at 90 until level 100.

achievements.description: Congratulations, your Bloob is now an Ultimate Imbuer
achievements.summary: Reach level 100 in Imbuing.

guide.context: Level 100 needs 14,391,160 XP in total.

steps.text: Collect imbued materials, such as Imbued Fibers or Imbued Glory. Turn them into slates at the lectern, then take the slates to an altar.
Make @item{Imbued Verdance Slate}s at level 66, @item{Imbued Radiance Slate}s at 76, @item{Imbued Void Slate}s at 86, then @item{Imbued Plasma Slate}s at 96 until level 100.

achievements.description: Congratulations, your Bloob is now an Ultimate Thief
achievements.summary: Reach level 100 in Thieving.

guide.context: A failed steal gives no XP and slightly hurts Bloob. Success chance rises with your Thieving and Dexterity levels.

steps.text: Reach level 60 @mechanic{Dexterity}, then steal from the @loc{Herbology Stall} in @loc{Forgotten Shore} at Thieving level 65, the @loc{Arrow & Slate Stall} at 75, and the @loc{Lumber Stall} at 85.
Reach level 85 @mechanic{Dexterity}, then steal from the @loc{Gem Stall} in @loc{Umberreach} at Thieving level 95 until level 100.

achievements.description: Congratulations, your Bloob is now an Ultimate BeastMaster
achievements.summary: Reach level 100 in Beastmastery.

guide.context: Each kill gives XP equal to 4 times the monster's level, and a boss task gives 5 times that. Train your combat levels first, because kills come faster.

steps.text: Keep taking tasks from @npc{Darko the Beastmaster}, including Elite and Champion tasks as they come, and finish each one.
Use @item{Auto BM} to chain tasks, and use strong gear and food so kills stay fast.

achievements.description: Congratulations, your Bloob is now an Ultimate Devotion Master
achievements.summary: Reach level 100 in Devotion.

guide.context: Burying remains gives little XP. Sacrificing vessels gives much more.

steps.text: Use the best vessel your Devotion level allows: Rotten Chalice at level 65, Ancient Trophy at 75, Titan's Cup at 85, and Bloomed Trophy at 95.

Your Beastmastery level decides if you can get each remains item: @item{Rotten Bones} need Beastmastery 60, @item{Sinister Bones} need 73, a @item{Giant Bone} needs 85 (or Tracking 190), and a @item{Bloomed Bone} needs 89. Rotten Bones drop from monsters of level 62 to 100, Sinister Bones from monsters of level 83 to 100, Giant Bones from Giants of level 87 to 110, and Bloomed Bones from monsters of level 93 to 145.
Make vessels from the remains with @item{Soft Clay} at the Crafting Kiln, and sacrifice them in the @loc{Ethereal Dungeon}.

achievements.description: Congratulations, your Bloob is now an Ultimate Magic Master
achievements.summary: Reach level 100 in the Magic skill.

guide.context: Each Magic level adds 0.10% accuracy and 0.15 damage.

steps.text: Keep slates stocked, because the cost changes with each spell tier. Storm spells (Magic 51) use 2 matching slates plus 4 @item{Imbued Blood Slate}. Blitz spells from Magic 70 use 2 Imbued Blood Slates plus 4 of the spell's own slate, such as @item{Imbued Verdance Slate}. At Magic 90 and 100 the spell's own slate cost is 5, ending with 5 @item{Imbued Plasma Slate} for Plasma Blitz.
Keep fighting monsters with spells and the strongest staff you can use until Magic reaches level 100.

achievements.description: Congratulations, your Bloob is now an Ultimate Range Master
achievements.summary: Reach level 100 in the Range skill.

guide.context: Each Range level adds 0.10% accuracy and 0.15 damage.

steps.text: Keep fighting monsters with the strongest bow and arrows you can use until Range reaches level 100.

achievements.description: Congratulations, your Bloob is now an Ultimate Defence Master
achievements.summary: Reach level 100 in the Defence skill.

steps.text: Open the combat style menu and choose Defence. The default melee style trains Attack, not Defence.
Keep fighting monsters in your best armour until Defence reaches level 100.

achievements.description: Congratulations, your Bloob is now an Ultimate Strength Master
achievements.summary: Reach level 100 in the Strength skill.

steps.text: Open the combat style menu and choose Strength. The default melee style trains Attack, not Strength.
Keep fighting monsters in melee with your best weapon until Strength reaches level 100.

achievements.description: Congratulations, your Bloob is now an Ultimate HitPoints Master
achievements.summary: Reach level 100 in the Hitpoints skill.

guide.context: The Beastmastery Shop sells an upgrade that makes Auto Eat heal for full food value.

steps.text: Keep @mechanic{Auto Eat} on and defeat monsters until Hitpoints reaches level 100.

achievements.description: Congratulations, your Bloob is now an Ultimate Tracking Master
achievements.summary: Reach level 100 in the Tracking skill.

steps.text: Keep moving up to the highest target your level allows. At level 95, track @enemy{Cerasilk Spider} in the @loc{Hinterlands} with a Phantom Cage. Keep going until Tracking reaches level 100.

achievements.description: Congratulations, your Bloob Now has 500 Total Level
achievements.summary: Reach a total level of 500, the sum of all your skill levels.

steps.text: Keep raising levels across all 24 skills until the total reaches 500.

achievements.description: Congratulations, your Bloob Now has 1000 Total Level
achievements.summary: Reach a total level of 1,000, the sum of all your skill levels.

steps.text: Keep raising levels across all 24 skills until the total reaches 1,000.

achievements.description: Congratulations, your Bloob Now has 1500 Total Level
achievements.summary: Reach a total level of 1,500, the sum of all your skill levels.

steps.text: Keep raising levels across all 24 skills until the total reaches 1,500.

achievements.description: Congratulations, your Bloob Now has 2000 Total Level
achievements.summary: Reach a total level of 2,000, the sum of all your skill levels.

guide.context: All 24 skills at about level 84 reach this total, so spread your training.

steps.text: Keep raising levels across all 24 skills until the total reaches 2,000.

achievements.description: Congratulations, your Bloob is now an Novice Woodcutter
achievements.summary: Reach level 20 in Woodcutting.

steps.text: Open the @mechanic{Woodcutting} guide from the Skills tab and click the best tree you can chop. Bloob walks there and chops.
Equip your best axe. Smith a better one when you can, or buy one at @npc{Nigel's General Store} in @loc{Havenport}.

achievements.description: Congratulations, your Bloob is now an Novice Firemaker
achievements.summary: Reach level 20 in Firemaking.

steps.text: Chop logs with @mechanic{Woodcutting}.
Open the @mechanic{Firemaking} guide and burn the best logs you can. Extra logs from other skills can be burned too.

achievements.description: Congratulations, your Bloob is now an Novice Fisher
achievements.summary: Reach level 20 in Fishing.

steps.text: Equip a rod. Buy one at @npc{Ned's Fishing Store} if you have none better.
Open the @mechanic{Fishing} guide, click a fish you can catch, and let Bloob fish.
A golden pop-up while fishing gives 150% XP and a guaranteed fish.

achievements.description: Congratulations, your Bloob is now an Novice Forager
achievements.summary: Reach level 20 in Foraging.

steps.text: Equip a lens. Buy one at @npc{Nigel's General Store} if you have none.
Open the @mechanic{Foraging} guide, click the best plant you can gather, and let Bloob work.

achievements.description: Congratulations, your Bloob is now an Novice BowCrafter
achievements.summary: Reach level 20 in Bowcrafting.

steps.text: Chop logs with @mechanic{Woodcutting}.
At the Workbench, craft @item{Shortbow U} from Logs until level 10.
Then craft @item{Oak Shortbow U} from Oak Logs until level 20.

achievements.description: Congratulations, your Bloob is now an Novice Cook
achievements.summary: Reach level 20 in Cooking.

steps.text: Catch fish or fight animals to get raw food.
Open the @mechanic{Cooking} guide, go to the cooking spot, and cook the best food you can.

achievements.description: Congratulations, your Bloob is now an Novice Smith
achievements.summary: Reach level 20 in Smithing.

steps.text: Mine copper and tin, then open the @mechanic{Smithing} guide and click @mechanic{Move to Forge}.
Smelt the ores into bars and smith items from them. Make arrow tips with extra bars to save inventory space.

achievements.description: Congratulations, your Bloob is now an Novice Miner
achievements.summary: Reach level 20 in Mining.

steps.text: Equip a pickaxe. Buy one at @npc{Nigel's General Store} if you have none better.
Open the @mechanic{Mining} guide, click the best ore you can mine, and let Bloob mine.

achievements.description: Congratulations, your Bloob is now an Novice Tracker
achievements.summary: Reach level 20 in the Tracking skill.

steps.text: Collect @item{Worm} bait at the Worms foraging node in @loc{Havenport} (Foraging level 2).
Track @enemy{Bloobbird} in Havenport with Worm bait.

At Tracking level 10 switch to @enemy{Orange Bloobbird}, still with Worm bait. At level 15 switch to @enemy{Silk Moth} in the @loc{Goblin Mines} with @item{Oak Logs} bait. Keep going until Tracking reaches level 20.

achievements.description: Congratulations, your Bloob is now an Novice Thief
achievements.summary: Reach level 20 in Thieving.

guide.context: A failed steal gives no XP and slightly hurts Bloob. Success chance rises with your Thieving and Dexterity levels.

steps.text: Steal from the @loc{Vegetable Stall} in @loc{Havenport} until level 15.
Then steal from the @loc{Bakery Stall} in @loc{Havenport} until level 20.

achievements.description: Congratulations, your Bloob is now an Novice Imbuer
achievements.summary: Reach level 20 in Imbuing.

steps.text: Collect imbued materials, such as Imbued Fibers or Imbued Glory. Turn them into slates at the lectern, then take the slates to an altar.
Make @item{Imbued Air Slate}s at the Altar of Elements from level 1, @item{Imbued Water Slate}s from level 8, then @item{Imbued Earth Slate}s from level 16 until level 20.

achievements.description: Congratulations, your Bloob is now an Novice Crafter
achievements.summary: Reach level 20 in Crafting.

steps.text: Collect uncut gems and Silver Bars, and cut the gems at the Crafting station.
Craft rings for your level: @item{Opal Ring} at level 2, @item{Jade Ring} at 12, then @item{Topaz Ring} at 16 until level 20.

achievements.description: Congratulations, your Bloob is now an Novice Herbologist
achievements.summary: Reach level 20 in Herbology.

steps.text: Make @item{Vial}s. Mine Sandstone north of Darko the Beastmaster in @loc{Havenport} for sand, then make @item{Molten Glass} from it. This needs Mining 15 and Crafting 5. Each Molten Glass makes 5 vials.
Fill vials with water at the @loc{Havenport} well. Combine each water vial with 3 herbs from Foraging to make an unfinished vial. Use Meadow Cress from level 1 to 11, then Sunsnap.

Add the second ingredient to finish each potion: Timber (level 1) uses Sticks, Excavation (4) uses Stones, Angling (7) uses Worm, Blaze (11) uses Ashes, and Artisan (17) uses Papyrus Fibers. Make the newest potion until level 20.

achievements.description: Congratulations, your Bloob is now an Novice Runner
achievements.summary: Reach level 20 in Dexterity.

steps.text: Run the @loc{Havenport Bloobathon} in central @loc{Havenport} again and again. Each lap gives 45 XP.
Run around the world between tasks. Bloob gets 4 Dexterity XP for every 6 tiles it travels.

achievements.description: Congratulations, your Bloob is now an Novice BeastMaster
achievements.summary: Reach level 20 in Beastmastery.

guide.context: Each kill gives XP equal to 4 times the monster's level, and a boss task gives 5 times that. Train your combat levels first, because kills come faster.

steps.text: Talk to @npc{Darko the Beastmaster}, just north of the town center in @loc{Havenport}, and take a task.
Kill the monsters you are assigned. Tasks are 20 to 30 monsters at the Easy tier.
Buy the @item{Auto BM} upgrade in the Beastmastery Shop so the next task starts by itself.

achievements.description: Congratulations, your Bloob is now an Novice Devotion Master
achievements.summary: Reach level 20 in Devotion.

guide.context: Burying remains gives little XP. Sacrificing vessels gives much more.

steps.text: Bury @item{Fish Bones}, @item{Bird Skull}s and @item{Bones} by clicking them in your inventory, or turn on @mechanic{Auto Bury} in the combat style menu.
Mine Clay (needs Mining level 5) and turn it into @item{Soft Clay} at the well. At the Crafting Kiln, combine Soft Clay with remains to make vessels.
Sacrifice the vessels at the chalice in the @loc{Ethereal Dungeon}, on the far west side of @loc{Northern Tharion Isles}.

achievements.description: Congratulations, your Bloob is now an Novice Mage
achievements.summary: Reach level 20 in the Magic skill.

steps.text: Buy a staff, @item{Imbued Air Slate} stacks and magic armour at @loc{Pear's Magic Store} in northern Havenport.
Cast Air Zap on monsters. Each cast uses one Imbued Air Slate, so keep slates in your inventory. Switch to Water Zap at Magic 5, Earth Zap at 9 and Fire Zap at 14, each with its own slate.
Keep fighting until Magic reaches level 20.

achievements.description: Congratulations, your Bloob is now an Novice Ranger
achievements.summary: Reach level 20 in the Range skill.

steps.text: Buy a shortbow and arrows at @loc{Ash's Range Weapons and Ammunition} in northern Havenport.
Fight monsters with the bow until Range reaches level 20.

achievements.description: Congratulations, your Bloob is now an Novice Defence Master
achievements.summary: Reach level 20 in the Defence skill.

steps.text: Wear the best armour your Defence level allows, such as armour from @npc{Gary's Armour} in central Havenport.
Open the combat style menu and choose Defence. The default melee style trains Attack, not Defence.
Keep fighting monsters until Defence reaches level 20.

achievements.description: Congratulations, your Bloob is now an Novice Strength Master
achievements.summary: Reach level 20 in the Strength skill.

steps.text: Buy a melee weapon at @loc{Dill's Weapons} in central Havenport and wear melee armour.
Open the combat style menu and choose Strength. The default melee style trains Attack, not Strength.
Fight monsters in melee until Strength reaches level 20.

achievements.description: Congratulations, your Bloob is now an Novice Attack Master
achievements.summary: Reach level 20 in Attack.

steps.text: Equip a melee weapon and matching melee armour. Your combat style switches to @mechanic{Attack} by default.
Turn on @mechanic{Auto Eat} with cooked food in your inventory.
Fight chickens at the chicken coop south and east of the bank, then move to stronger monsters as you level.

achievements.description: Congratulations, your Bloob is now an Novice HitPoints Master
achievements.summary: Reach level 20 in the Hitpoints skill.

guide.context: Hitpoints XP comes from kills, so only defeated monsters count.

steps.text: Turn on @mechanic{Auto Eat} in the equipment tab or game settings.
Defeat monsters until Hitpoints reaches level 20.

achievements.description: Congratulations, your Bloob Now has 250 Total Level
achievements.summary: Reach a total level of 250, the sum of all your skill levels.

guide.context: Total level adds every skill's level together. Play on a main save, not Turbo Mode.

steps.text: Train any skills. Every level in any skill adds 1.

achievements.description: Congratulations, your Bloob Now has 750 Total Level
achievements.summary: Reach a total level of 750, the sum of all your skill levels.

steps.text: Keep raising levels across all 24 skills until the total reaches 750.

achievements.description: Adept Woodcutter Congratulations, your Bloob is now an Adept Woodcutter
achievements.summary: Reach level 60 in Woodcutting.

guide.context: Level 60 needs 273,742 XP in total.

steps.text: Chop the highest tree your level allows with your best axe.
Drink a @item{Timber Potion} while you chop. It adds 10 progress to every chop.
A golden pop-up on the tree gives 150% XP and an extra log.

achievements.description: Congratulations, your Bloob is now an Adept Firemaker
achievements.summary: Reach level 60 in Firemaking.

guide.context: Level 60 needs 273,742 XP in total.

steps.text: Burn the best logs your level allows.
Once you have Devotion level 32 and Devotion Points, channel @mechanic{Flame's Favor} for 5% more Firemaking XP.

achievements.description: Congratulations, your Bloob is now an Adept Fisher
achievements.summary: Reach level 60 in Fishing.

guide.context: Level 60 needs 273,742 XP in total.

steps.text: Fish the best node your level allows with your best rod.
Drink an @item{Angling Potion} while you fish. It adds 10 progress to each catch.
Once you have Devotion level 67 and Devotion Points, channel @mechanic{Fisher's Season} for 15% more Fishing XP.

achievements.description: Congratulations, your Bloob is now an Adept Forager
achievements.summary: Reach level 60 in Foraging.

guide.context: Level 60 needs 273,742 XP in total.

steps.text: Gather the best plant your level allows. Gathers get faster with a better lens.
Upgrade your lens when you can. Lens upgrades need @item{Molten Glass}.
A golden pop-up on the plant gives 150% XP and an extra copy.

achievements.description: Congratulations, your Bloob is now an Adept BowCrafter
achievements.summary: Reach level 60 in Bowcrafting.

guide.context: Level 60 needs 273,742 XP in total.

steps.text: Craft the Unstrung Shortbow for the best logs you can use: @item{Willow Shortbow U} at level 20, @item{Teak Shortbow U} at 30, @item{Maple Shortbow U} at 40, then @item{Acadia Shortbow U} at 50 until level 60.

achievements.description: Congratulations, your Bloob is now an Adept Cook
achievements.summary: Reach level 60 in Cooking.

guide.context: Level 60 needs 273,742 XP in total.

steps.text: Collect large stacks of raw food from Fishing or combat.
Cook the best food your level allows until level 60.

achievements.description: Congratulations, your Bloob is now an Adept Smith
achievements.summary: Reach level 60 in Smithing.

guide.context: Level 60 needs 273,742 XP in total.

steps.text: Bring ore and @item{Coal Ore} to the forge and smelt the best bar you can.
Smith items from those bars. Put spare bars into arrow tips or Lockpicks to save inventory space, because you use them later.

achievements.description: Congratulations, your Bloob is now an Adept Miner
achievements.summary: Reach level 60 in Mining.

guide.context: Level 60 needs 273,742 XP in total.

steps.text: Mine the best ore your level allows with your best pickaxe. Smith a better pickaxe when you can.
Drink an @item{Excavation Potion} while you mine. It adds 10 progress to each swing.
A golden pop-up on the ore gives 150% XP and an extra ore.

achievements.description: Congratulations, your Bloob is now an Adept Tracker
achievements.summary: Reach level 60 in the Tracking skill.

guide.context: Traps for Tracking targets are made with the Smithing skill.

steps.text: From level 25, track @enemy{Wild Boar} in the western @loc{Tharion Isles} with a Metal Trap and @item{Twilight Orchidshroom} bait. At level 30, track @enemy{Elderglow Spider} at @loc{Shadowfangs Point} with a Cage.
At level 40, track @enemy{Fireweave Spider} on @loc{Entropy Island} with a Cage. You need Dexterity level 38.
At level 55, track @enemy{Shadowweave Buffalo} in the south-west @loc{Tharion Isles} with a Metal Trap and @item{Purple Bloobberries} bait.
Keep tracking until Tracking reaches level 60.

achievements.description: Congratulations, your Bloob is now an Adept Thief
achievements.summary: Reach level 60 in Thieving.

guide.context: A failed steal gives no XP and slightly hurts Bloob. Success chance rises with your Thieving and Dexterity levels.

steps.text: Steal from the @loc{Butcher Stall} in @loc{Havenport} at level 25, the @loc{Fish Stall} at 40, then the @loc{Ore Stall} at 55 until level 60.

achievements.description: Congratulations, your Bloob is now an Adept Imbuer
achievements.summary: Reach level 60 in Imbuing.

guide.context: Level 60 needs 273,742 XP in total.

steps.text: Collect imbued materials, such as Imbued Fibers or Imbued Glory. Turn them into slates at the lectern, then take the slates to an altar.

Make @item{Imbued Fire Slate}s at level 24, @item{Imbued Disruption Slate}s at 32, @item{Imbued Rift Slate}s at 40, @item{Imbued Entropy Slate}s at 48, then @item{Imbued Blood Slate}s at 56 until level 60.

achievements.description: Congratulations, your Bloob is now an Adept Crafter
achievements.summary: Reach level 60 in Crafting.

guide.context: Level 60 needs 273,742 XP in total.

steps.text: Reach level 40 @mechanic{Smithing} so you can make Gold Bars.
Craft the best jewellery for your level: @item{Sapphire Necklace} at level 31, @item{Emerald Necklace} at 40, then @item{Ruby Necklace} at 55 until level 60.

achievements.description: Congratulations, your Bloob is now an Adept Herbologist
achievements.summary: Reach level 60 in Herbology.

guide.context: Level 60 needs 273,742 XP in total.

steps.text: Fill vials with water at the @loc{Havenport} well. Mix each water vial with 3 herbs, then add the potion's second ingredient.
Make the newest potion you have unlocked: Fletcher (level 21), Precision (27), Rogue (31), Acuity (37), Gatherer (41), Seer (47), Charge (51), Faith (54), then Swiftness (57) until level 60.

achievements.description: Congratulations, your Bloob is now an Adept Runner
achievements.summary: Reach level 60 in Dexterity.

guide.context: Level 60 needs 273,742 XP in total.

steps.text: Run the best Bloobathon you have the level for. Havenport Extended opens at level 25, Tharion at 40, and Tharion Extended at 55.
Wear @item{Run Speed Boots} if you have found a pair, since they speed up each lap.

achievements.description: Congratulations, your Bloob is now an Adept BeastMaster
achievements.summary: Reach level 60 in Beastmastery.

guide.context: Each kill gives XP equal to 4 times the monster's level, and a boss task gives 5 times that. Train your combat levels first, because kills come faster.

steps.text: Keep taking tasks from @npc{Darko the Beastmaster} and finish each one. Harder tiers assign stronger monsters, so raise your combat levels as you go.
Use @item{Auto BM} to chain tasks.

achievements.description: Bloob is now an Adept Devotion Master
achievements.summary: Reach level 60 in Devotion.

guide.context: Burying remains gives little XP. Sacrificing vessels gives much more.

steps.text: Use the best vessel your Devotion level allows: Toxic Vessel at level 42, Spectral Trophy at 48, and Necrotic Chalice at 55.

Each vessel also needs its remains, and your Beastmastery or Tracking level decides if you can get them: Toxic Bones need Beastmastery 18, Spectral Dust needs Beastmastery 35 or Tracking 45, and @item{Necrotic Bones} need Beastmastery 40 or Tracking 75. Necrotic Bones drop from Bound Cadavers, Unraveling Crawlers, Warped Wyverns, Verdict and The Eye.
Make vessels from the remains with @item{Soft Clay} at the Crafting Kiln, and sacrifice them in the @loc{Ethereal Dungeon}.

achievements.description: Congratulations, your Bloob is now an Adept Mage
achievements.summary: Reach level 60 in the Magic skill.

guide.context: Magic armour keeps your accuracy high. Mixed gear lowers it.

steps.text: Swap to a better staff whenever your Magic level allows one.

Keep slates stocked, because the cost changes with each spell tier. Zap spells use 1 matching Imbued Slate. Pulse spells (Magic 18) add 2 @item{Imbued Disruption Slate}. Beam spells (Magic 34) use 2 matching slates plus 3 @item{Imbued Entropy Slate}. Storm spells (Magic 51) use 2 matching slates plus 4 @item{Imbued Blood Slate}.
Keep fighting monsters with spells until Magic reaches level 60.

achievements.description: Congratulations, your Bloob is now an Adept Ranger
achievements.summary: Reach level 60 in the Range skill.

guide.context: Range armour keeps your accuracy high with a bow. Mixed gear lowers it.

steps.text: Swap to a better bow and arrows whenever your Range level allows.
Keep fighting monsters with the bow until Range reaches level 60.

achievements.description: Congratulations, your Bloob is now an Adept Defence Master
achievements.summary: Reach level 60 in the Defence skill.

steps.text: Open the combat style menu and choose Defence. The default melee style trains Attack, not Defence.
Upgrade your armour whenever your Defence level allows.
Keep fighting monsters until Defence reaches level 60.

achievements.description: Congratulations, your Bloob is now an Adept Attack Master
achievements.summary: Reach level 60 in Attack.

guide.context: Level 60 needs 273,742 XP in total.

steps.text: Upgrade your melee weapon each time you reach its level, up to the @item{Sanguinite Dagger} at level 60.
Wear melee armour so your accuracy stays high.
Boost accuracy with a @item{Precision Potion} (Herbology 27) or the @mechanic{Bloob's Fury} invocation (Devotion 30), then keep fighting strong monsters.

achievements.description: Congratulations, your Bloob is now an Adept HitPoints Master
achievements.summary: Reach level 60 in the Hitpoints skill.

steps.text: Keep @mechanic{Auto Eat} on and defeat monsters until Hitpoints reaches level 60.

achievements.description: Congratulations, your Bloob is now an Adept Strength Master
achievements.summary: Reach level 60 in the Strength skill.

steps.text: Open the combat style menu and choose Strength. The default melee style trains Attack, not Strength.
Upgrade your melee weapon whenever your levels allow.
Keep fighting monsters in melee until Strength reaches level 60.

achievements.description: Congratulations, your Bloob Now has 2500 Total Level
achievements.summary: Reach a total level of 2,500, the sum of all your skill levels.

guide.context: All 24 skills at level 100 add up to 2,400, which is 100 short of 2,500. Skills can be trained past level 100.

steps.text: Keep raising your skill levels until the total reaches 2,500.

achievements.description: Congratulations, your Bloob Now has 2200 Total Level
achievements.summary: Reach a total level of 2,200, the sum of all your skill levels.

guide.context: All 24 skills at about level 92 reach this total.

steps.text: Keep raising levels across all 24 skills until the total reaches 2,200.

achievements.description: You picked up your first Banana.
achievements.summary: Get a Banana into your inventory.

guide.context: Aqua Island needs level 35 in the Dexterity skill, and you cannot auto-path there. Petting Gary has a 1% chance to give a Banana.

steps.text: Raise Dexterity to level 35.
Walk to @loc{Aqua Island}, past the upper @loc{Tharion Isles} towards the north-east.
Click @npc{Gary} the monkey to pet him until he gives a @item{Banana}.

achievements.description: You picked up your first Chocolate Egg.
achievements.summary: Get a Chocolate Egg as a drop from the Easter Bunny or Mega Chicken.

guide.context: Each kill of either boss has a 1 in 1,000 chance of dropping the egg. The bosses need level 50 Beastmastery and fight in melee.

Find the barn near the chickens in @loc{Havenport} and click the egg basket.
Defeat @enemy{Easter Bunny} or @enemy{Mega Chicken} again and again until a @item{Chocolate Egg} drops.

guide.context: You only earn Soulbinding XP while at least one soul is active, and it comes from XP you gain in your other skills.

steps.text: Get a soul, for example from @npc{Souly's Soul Store} on @loc{Tharion Isle}, and make it active in the @mechanic{Souldex}.
Train any other skills until Soulbinding reaches level 20.

achievements.description: Congratulations, your Bloob is now an Adept Soulbinding Master
achievements.summary: Reach level 60 in the Soulbinding skill.

guide.context: Each active soul adds to the Soulbinding XP you earn, and higher levels unlock more soul slots.

steps.text: Keep as many souls active as your slots allow.
Train other skills until Soulbinding reaches level 60.

achievements.description: Congratulations, your Bloob is now an Ultimate Soulbinding Master
achievements.summary: Reach level 100 in the Soulbinding skill.

steps.text: Keep every soul slot filled with an active soul.
Train other skills until Soulbinding reaches level 100.

achievements.description: Congratulations You have Discovered Your First Soul
achievements.summary: Discover 1 soul in the Souldex.

guide.context: You pay gold for souls at the store, and you can buy each soul only once. Monsters and skills can also drop souls by chance.

steps.text: Sail from the @loc{Havenport} dock to @loc{Tharion Isle} for 60 coins.
Buy a soul at @npc{Souly's Soul Store}, above the Ethereal Dungeon.

achievements.description: Congratulations You have Now Discovered ten Souls !!
achievements.summary: Discover 10 different souls in the Souldex.

guide.context: The 10 cheapest souls cost 1,501,000 Bloob Coins in total.

steps.text: Sail from the @loc{Havenport} dock to @loc{Tharion Isle} and visit @npc{Souly's Soul Store}, above the Ethereal Dungeon.
Buy the cheapest souls first: @item{Chick Soul} (1,000 coins), @item{Duck Soul} (25,000), @item{Goose Soul} (75,000), @item{Pigeon Soul} (100,000) and @item{Blue Jay Soul} (150,000).
Keep buying the next cheapest souls until 10 appear in the Souldex. Monster kills can also drop souls.

achievements.description: Congratulations You have Now Discovered Twenty Five Souls !!

Buy the cheapest Regular souls first, from Chick Soul (1,000 coins) and Duck Soul (25,000) up to Ram Soul (650,000) as the 25th. The 25 cheapest cost 8,331,000 coins in total. Monster kills can also drop souls.

achievements.description: Congratulations You have Now Discovered Fifty Souls !!

steps.text: Buy every Regular soul (30 in all) in @npc{Souly's Soul Store} on @loc{Tharion Isle}, not the Golden or Corrupted ones.
Hunt monsters, bosses and Tracking targets for the remaining souls, and keep gaining skill XP for more chances.

steps.text: Earn Bloob Coins by selling items to any shop. Smithing is a steady source, because armour sells for more than its materials.

Visit @loc{The Bank} in Havenport, next to the central teleport, and buy slots until you have bought 1,000.

achievements.description: You'll Get Them Next Time

guide.context: Dying has no penalty, but Bloob stops whatever task he was doing.

steps.text: Turn off @mechanic{Auto Eat} in the Equipment tab or in Game Settings (the cog tab), and carry no food.
Keep Auto Eat off and keep fighting a Chicken in West Havenport until Bloob's Hitpoints reach 0 and he respawns.

steps.text: Go to the Havenport Bloobathon and start it.

steps.text: Steal from the @loc{Havenport} Vegetable Stall, which needs Thieving level 1, until you have 100 successes.
Check your total on the @mechanic{Stats Board} next to the bank.

achievements.description: Successfully Thieved 1,000 Times
achievements.summary: Successfully steal 1,000 times with the Thieving skill.

guide.context: Raising your Thieving and Dexterity levels cuts failed attempts: each Thieving level adds 0.30% success chance and each Dexterity level adds 0.15%.

steps.text: Steal from the best @loc{Havenport} stall your level allows: Vegetable Stall at level 1, Bakery Stall at 15, Butcher Stall at 25, Fish Stall at 40, Ore Stall at 55.
Check the total on the @mechanic{Stats Board} until it reaches 1,000.

achievements.description: Successfully Thieved 10,000 Times
achievements.summary: Successfully steal 10,000 times with the Thieving skill.

guide.context: Stalls in the Forgotten Shore need Dexterity level 60 as well as the listed Thieving level.

steps.text: Keep stealing from your best stall: Ore Stall at level 55 in @loc{Havenport}, or the Herbology Stall (65), Arrow & Slate Stall (75) and Lumber Stall (85) in the @loc{Forgotten Shore}.
Check the total on the @mechanic{Stats Board} until it reaches 10,000.

achievements.description: Mine 100 Ores
achievements.summary: Mine 100 ores.

guide.context: A Bronze Pickaxe removes only 25 of an ore's 100 progress per swing, so early ores take several swings each.

steps.text: Keep a pickaxe in your inventory and mine @item{Copper Ore} and @item{Tin Ore} in the @loc{Goblin Mines}; they need Mining level 1 and 2.
Check your ore total on the @mechanic{Stats Board} next to the bank.

achievements.description: Mine 1,000 Ores
achievements.summary: Mine 1,000 ores.

guide.context: Better pickaxes remove more progress per swing, so each ore takes fewer swings. Steel Pickaxe needs level 20 and Mithril Pickaxe needs level 30.

steps.text: Mine the best ore your Mining level allows with your best pickaxe.
Check the ore total on the @mechanic{Stats Board} until it reaches 1,000.

achievements.description: Mine 10,000 Ores
achievements.summary: Mine 10,000 ores.

guide.context: High-tier pickaxes remove 100 progress or more per swing, so one swing yields one ore.

steps.text: Mine the best ore your Mining level allows with your best pickaxe until the @mechanic{Stats Board} ore total reaches 10,000.

achievements.description: Forage 100 Items
achievements.summary: Forage 100 items.

steps.text: Keep a Lens in your inventory or equipped. Pick @item{Bloobberries} from Bloobberry Bushes in @loc{Havenport}, which need Foraging level 1, until the @mechanic{Forager's Log} in the Codex shows 100 items foraged.

achievements.description: Forage 1,000 Items
achievements.summary: Forage 1,000 items.

guide.context: Each forage gives more items as Foraging rises: 2 at level 10 and 3 at level 30.

steps.text: Keep a Lens in your inventory or equipped. Keep foraging the best resource your Foraging level allows until the @mechanic{Forager's Log} in the Codex shows 1,000 items foraged.

achievements.description: Forage 10,000 Items
achievements.summary: Forage 10,000 items.

guide.context: At Foraging level 90 each forage gives 6 items, which makes the last stretch much quicker.

steps.text: Keep a Lens in your inventory or equipped. Keep foraging the best resource your Foraging level allows until the @mechanic{Forager's Log} in the Codex shows 10,000 items foraged.

achievements.description: Defeat Mumma Chicken for the first time.
achievements.summary: Kill the boss Mumma Chicken once.

guide.context: She can be attacked at any Beastmastery level. After a kill she respawns after 60 seconds.

steps.text: Go to West @loc{Havenport} and defeat @enemy{Mumma Chicken}.

achievements.description: Defeat Brainbasher for the first time.
achievements.summary: Kill the boss Brainbasher once.

steps.text: Reach Beastmastery level 6 by finishing tasks from @npc{Darko the Beastmaster}, north of the Havenport town centre.
Go to the @loc{Goblin Mines} and defeat @enemy{Brainbasher}.

achievements.description: Defeat Momma for the first time. Cow
achievements.summary: Kill the boss Momma Cow once.

steps.text: Reach Beastmastery level 7 by finishing tasks from @npc{Darko the Beastmaster}, north of the Havenport town centre.
Go to Central @loc{Havenport} and defeat @enemy{Momma Cow}.

achievements.description: Defeat Mumma Sheep for the first time.
achievements.summary: Kill the boss Mumma Sheep once.

steps.text: Reach Beastmastery level 9 by finishing tasks from @npc{Darko the Beastmaster}, north of the Havenport town centre.
Sail from the @loc{Havenport Dock} to the @loc{Tharion Isles Dock}; the trip costs 60 coins.
Walk to the farm in the west of the @loc{Upper Tharion Isles} and defeat @enemy{Mumma Sheep}.

achievements.description: Defeat Momma Pig for the first time.
achievements.summary: Kill the boss Momma Pig once.

steps.text: Reach Beastmastery level 10 by finishing tasks from @npc{Darko the Beastmaster}, north of the Havenport town centre.
Sail from the @loc{Havenport Dock} to the @loc{Tharion Isles Dock}; the trip costs 60 coins.
Walk to the farm in the west of the @loc{Upper Tharion Isles} and defeat @enemy{Momma Pig}.

achievements.description: Defeat Amaruq for the first time.
achievements.summary: Kill the boss Amaruq once.

steps.text: Reach Beastmastery level 12 by finishing tasks from @npc{Darko the Beastmaster}, north of the Havenport town centre.
Go to North-West @loc{Havenport}, north of the Havenport Waypoint, and defeat @enemy{Amaruq}.

achievements.description: Defeat Gnoll Chief for the first time.
achievements.summary: Kill the boss Gnoll Chief once.

steps.text: Reach Beastmastery level 18 by finishing tasks from @npc{Darko the Beastmaster}, north of the Havenport town centre.

Sail from the @loc{Havenport Dock} to the @loc{Tharion Isles Dock}; the trip costs 60 coins. Then go to the @loc{Gnoll Hideout}, a dungeon on the northern side of the @loc{Upper Tharion Isles}, and defeat @enemy{Gnoll Chief}.

achievements.description: Defeat Dave The Brawler for the first time.
achievements.summary: Kill the boss Dave The Brawler once.

guide.context: Bloob needs Firemaking level 15 to enter the Hollow Mine.

steps.text: Reach Beastmastery level 18 by finishing tasks from @npc{Darko the Beastmaster}, north of the Havenport town centre.
Go to the @loc{Hollow Mine} and defeat @enemy{Dave The Brawler}.

achievements.description: Defeat Shadowfang for the first time.
achievements.summary: Kill the boss Shadowfang once.

steps.text: Reach Beastmastery level 21 by finishing tasks from @npc{Darko the Beastmaster}, north of the Havenport town centre.
Sail from the @loc{Havenport Dock} to the @loc{Tharion Isles Dock}; the trip costs 60 coins.
Travel west of the Upper Tharion Isles to @loc{Shadowfang Point} and defeat @enemy{Shadowfang}.

achievements.description: Defeat Twinfang for the first time
achievements.summary: Kill the boss Twinfang The Blight Bringer once.

guide.context: Bloob needs Thieving level 30 to enter the Toxic Pit.

steps.text: Reach Beastmastery level 40 by finishing tasks from @npc{Darko the Beastmaster}, north of the Havenport town centre.

Sail from the @loc{Havenport Dock} to the @loc{Tharion Isles Dock}; the trip costs 60 coins. Then head to the @loc{Toxic Pit} dungeon in the far north-eastern part of the @loc{Upper Tharion Isles} and defeat @enemy{Twinfang The Blight Bringer}.

achievements.description: Defeat Shellcrusher for the first time.
achievements.summary: Kill the boss Shellcrusher once.

guide.context: Dexterity level 35 is needed to sail the rough water between Cape Crab and Shellcrusher Island.

steps.text: Reach Beastmastery level 40 by finishing tasks from @npc{Darko the Beastmaster}, north of the Havenport town centre.
Go to Cape Crab on the east side of the Lower Tharion Isles, cross to @loc{Shellcrusher Island} and defeat @enemy{Shellcrusher}.

achievements.description: Defeat Graveheart for the first time.
achievements.summary: Kill the boss Graveheart The Revenant Overlord once.

guide.context: The Tharion Catacombs need Firemaking level 40 and Graveheart's boss room needs Thieving level 45.

steps.text: Reach Beastmastery level 50 by finishing tasks from @npc{Darko the Beastmaster}, north of the Havenport town centre.

Sail from the @loc{Havenport Dock} to the @loc{Tharion Isles Dock}; the trip costs 60 coins. Then enter the @loc{Tharion Catacombs} in the centre of the @loc{Upper Tharion Isles}, go to the first floor boss room and defeat @enemy{Graveheart The Revenant Overlord}.

achievements.description: Defeat Pestilence for the first time.
achievements.summary: Kill the boss Pestilence once.

guide.context: The Toxic Pit needs Thieving level 30 and Pestilence's room needs Dexterity level 55.

steps.text: Reach Beastmastery level 55 by finishing tasks from @npc{Darko the Beastmaster}, north of the Havenport town centre.

Sail from the @loc{Havenport Dock} to the @loc{Tharion Isles Dock}; the trip costs 60 coins. Then go to the @loc{Toxic Pit} in the far north-eastern part of the @loc{Upper Tharion Isles}, enter Pestilence's room and defeat @enemy{Pestilence}.

achievements.description: Defeat Verdict for the first time.
achievements.summary: Kill the boss Verdict once.

guide.context: The Tharion Catacombs need Firemaking level 40. The second floor needs Dexterity level 45 and Thieving level 55.

steps.text: Reach Beastmastery level 60 by finishing tasks from @npc{Darko the Beastmaster}, north of the Havenport town centre.

Sail from the @loc{Havenport Dock} to the @loc{Tharion Isles Dock}; the trip costs 60 coins. Then enter the @loc{Tharion Catacombs} in the centre of the @loc{Upper Tharion Isles}, take the second floor and defeat @enemy{Verdict}.

achievements.description: Defeat The Eye for the first time.
achievements.summary: Kill the boss The Eye once.

guide.context: The Tharion Catacombs need Firemaking level 40. The second floor needs Dexterity level 45 and Thieving level 55.

steps.text: Reach Beastmastery level 74 by finishing tasks from @npc{Darko the Beastmaster}, north of the Havenport town centre.

Sail from the @loc{Havenport Dock} to the @loc{Tharion Isles Dock}; the trip costs 60 coins. Then enter the @loc{Tharion Catacombs} in the centre of the @loc{Upper Tharion Isles}, take the second floor and defeat @enemy{The Eye}.

achievements.description: Defeat Onyx Widow for the first time.
achievements.summary: Kill the boss Onyx Widow once.

guide.context: The Ancient Dungeon needs Thieving level 60, Firemaking level 70 and Dexterity level 65.

steps.text: Reach Beastmastery level 80 by finishing tasks from @npc{Darko the Beastmaster}, north of the Havenport town centre.
Go to the @loc{Ancient Dungeon} and defeat @enemy{Onyx Widow}.

achievements.description: Defeat Vaerthrax for the first time.
achievements.summary: Kill the boss Vaerthrax, the Ebon Maw once.

guide.context: Umberreach needs Dexterity level 60.

steps.text: Reach Beastmastery level 84 by finishing tasks from @npc{Darko the Beastmaster}, north of the Havenport town centre.
Go to southeastern @loc{Umberreach} and defeat @enemy{Vaerthrax}.

achievements.description: Defeat Vermithrax for the first time.
achievements.summary: Kill the boss Vermithrax the Bloodbound once.

guide.context: Sanguis Reach needs Dexterity level 60.

steps.text: Reach Beastmastery level 88 by finishing tasks from @npc{Darko the Beastmaster}, north of the Havenport town centre.
Go to @loc{Sanguis Reach} and defeat @enemy{Vermithrax}.

achievements.description: Defeat Gorthank for the first time.
achievements.summary: Kill the boss Gorthank the Twin-Titan once.

guide.context: The Forgotten Shore needs Dexterity level 60.

steps.text: Reach Beastmastery level 94 by finishing tasks from @npc{Darko the Beastmaster}, north of the Havenport town centre.
Sail from the @loc{Havenport Dock} to the @loc{Forgotten Shore Dock}; the trip costs 5,000 coins.
Go to the @loc{Forgotten Shore} and defeat @enemy{Gorthank the Twin-Titan}.

achievements.description: Defeat Braknor for the first time.
achievements.summary: Kill the boss Braknor the Bloodhoof once.

guide.context: The Forgotten Shore needs Dexterity level 60.

steps.text: Reach Beastmastery level 100 by finishing tasks from @npc{Darko the Beastmaster}, north of the Havenport town centre.
Sail from the @loc{Havenport Dock} to the @loc{Forgotten Shore Dock}; the trip costs 5,000 coins.
Go to the @loc{Forgotten Shore} and defeat @enemy{Braknor the Bloodhoof}.

achievements.description: Defeat Nessy Core for the first time.
achievements.summary: Kill the boss Nessy Core once.

guide.context: Nessy's Peak needs at least Dexterity level 92.

steps.text: Reach Beastmastery level 125 by finishing tasks from @npc{Darko the Beastmaster}, north of the Havenport town centre.
Go to @loc{Nessy's Peak} and defeat @enemy{Nessy Core}.

achievements.description: Defeat Frostmaw Yeti for the first time.
achievements.summary: Kill the boss Frostmaw Yeti once.

guide.context: The Hinterlands need Dexterity level 92.

steps.text: Reach Beastmastery level 150 by finishing tasks from @npc{Darko the Beastmaster}, north of the Havenport town centre.
Go to the @loc{Hinterlands} and defeat @enemy{Frostmaw Yeti}.

achievements.description: Defeat Malachite Maw for the first time.
achievements.summary: Kill the boss Malachite Maw once.

guide.context: The Hinterlands need Dexterity level 92.

steps.text: Reach Beastmastery level 175 by finishing tasks from @npc{Darko the Beastmaster}, north of the Havenport town centre.
Go to the @loc{Hinterlands} and defeat @enemy{Malachite Maw}.

achievements.description: Defeat Glazarth for the first time.
achievements.summary: Kill the boss Glazarth the Glacierborn once.

guide.context: Glazarth needs Dexterity level 175 and Firemaking level 150 to reach.

steps.text: Reach Beastmastery level 200 by finishing tasks from @npc{Darko the Beastmaster}, north of the Havenport town centre.
Go to @loc{Nessy's Peak} and defeat @enemy{Glazarth the Glacierborn}.

achievements.description: Congratulations, your Bloob is now an Novice Homesteader
achievements.summary: Reach level 20 in Homesteading.

guide.context: Homesteading experience comes from growing crops, eggs and geodes at the Homestead. Level 20 needs 4,470 experience in total.

steps.text: Enter the @loc{Homestead} through the green portal next to Ned's Rods in @loc{Havenport}.
Plant and harvest seeds on the Homestead plots. @item{Bloobberry Seed} gives 270 Homesteading experience at level 1; get it from a 1% drop while foraging.
Keep growing until Homesteading reaches level 20.

achievements.description: Congratulations, your Bloob is now an Adept Homesteader
achievements.summary: Reach level 60 in Homesteading.

guide.context: Level 60 needs 273,742 experience in total. Every seed starts at 15 seconds of growth time, and each Homesteading level removes 0.02 seconds.

steps.text: Grow the highest-experience seed your Homesteading level allows on the Homestead plots.
Keep growing until Homesteading reaches level 60.

achievements.description: Congratulations, your Bloob is now an Master Homesteader
achievements.summary: Reach level 100 in Homesteading.

guide.context: Level 100 needs 14,391,160 experience in total. Seed Research Table upgrades shorten growth time, and the level itself removes 0.02 seconds per level.

steps.text: Grow the highest-experience seed your Homesteading level allows on the Homestead plots.
Build the @item{Strawbound Hut}, then buy the @item{Regular Research Table} at the @mechanic{Seed Research Table}; each research bought shortens growth time.
Keep growing until Homesteading reaches level 100.

achievements.description: Congratulations, You've built your first Home !! Strawbound Hut
achievements.summary: Build the Strawbound Hut, the first house on the Homestead.

guide.context: The Strawbound Hut needs no Homesteading level and unlocks the Seed Research Table. Houses and their unlocks stay after prestiging Homesteading.

steps.text: Enter the @loc{Homestead} through the green portal next to Ned's Rods in @loc{Havenport}.
Collect 1,000 @item{Logs}, 600 @item{Wool}, 500 @item{String} and 500 @item{Stones}.
Build the @item{Strawbound Hut}.

achievements.description: Congratulations, You've built the Longhouse !!!
achievements.summary: Build the Longhouse, the fifth house on the Homestead.

guide.context: Houses must be built in order, and the Longhouse needs Homesteading level 100. It also adds a bank on the Homestead.

steps.text: Build the @item{Timber Cabin} at Homesteading level 25: 8,000 Oak Logs, 1,000 Willow Logs, 100 Sandstone, 5,000 Soft Clay and 1,000 Wool.
Build the @item{Stonewood Lodge} at level 50: 8,000 Teak Logs, 1,000 Maple Logs, 15,000 Stones, 5,000 Soft Clay, 500 Iron Bars and 500 Silk.
Build the @item{Reinforced Lodge} at level 75: 10,000 Maple Logs, 1,000 Acadia Logs, 15,000 Stones, 25,000 Sticks, 500 Steel Bars and 500 Molten Glass.
Reach Homesteading level 100, then build the @item{Longhouse}: 20,000 Eucalyptus Logs, 5,000 Yew Logs, 25,000 Stones, 25,000 Soft Clay, 5,000 Cotton and 500 Steel Bars.

achievements.description: Congratulations, You've built the Manor House !!!
achievements.summary: Build the Manor House, the seventh house on the Homestead.

guide.context: Houses must be built in order, so the Great Hall comes first. The Manor House needs Homesteading level 200, which needs 157,069,100 experience in total, and it unlocks the Homestead Teleport.

steps.text: Reach Homesteading level 150, then build the @item{Great Hall} with 500 Silver Bars, 5,000 String, 25,000 Stones, 25,000 Soft Clay, 5,000 Red Maple Logs and 20,000 Yew Logs.
Reach Homesteading level 200, then build the @item{Manor House} with 2,000 Gold Bars, 25,000 Stones, 25,000 Soft Clay, 5,000 Magic Logs and 20,000 Red Maple Logs.

achievements.description: Grow 100 Crops
achievements.summary: Grow 100 crops on the Homestead.

steps.text: Get seeds: pickpocket a Villager at Thieving level 1 for a 1.4% chance of 3-6 @item{Parsnip Seed}, or forage for a 1% chance of @item{Bloobberry Seed}.
Plant seeds on the @loc{Homestead} plots and harvest them until the @mechanic{Stats Board} crops total reaches 100.

achievements.description: Grow 1000 Crops
achievements.summary: Grow 1,000 crops on the Homestead.

guide.context: Growth time falls with Homesteading level and with Seed Research Table upgrades.

steps.text: Keep planting and harvesting seeds on the @loc{Homestead} plots until the @mechanic{Stats Board} crops total reaches 1,000.

achievements.description: Grow 10000 Crops
achievements.summary: Grow 10,000 crops on the Homestead.

guide.context: Prestiging Homesteading adds an Instant Grow Chance of 1.5% to 15% and a Double Crop Chance of 2% to 20%.

steps.text: Keep planting and harvesting seeds on the @loc{Homestead} plots until the @mechanic{Stats Board} crops total reaches 10,000.

achievements.description: Grow 100000 Crops
achievements.summary: Grow 100,000 crops on the Homestead.

guide.context: The Adobe Hut, a Homesteading level 300 house, makes planting draw seeds directly from the bank when inventory seeds are gone.

steps.text: Keep planting and harvesting seeds on the @loc{Homestead} plots until the @mechanic{Stats Board} crops total reaches 100,000.

achievements.description: Upgrade 1 Seed Research Table
achievements.summary: Research 1 upgrade at the Seed Research Table.

guide.context: The table appears in your house once the Strawbound Hut is built. Buying is instant and takes the items from your inventory.

steps.text: Build the @item{Strawbound Hut} and open the @mechanic{Seed Research Table} inside it.
Collect 5,000 @item{Logs} and 2,000 @item{Parsnip}, then buy the @item{Regular Research Table}, which needs Homesteading level 1.

achievements.description: Upgrade 5 Seed Research Table
achievements.summary: Research 5 upgrades at the Seed Research Table.

guide.context: Research must be bought in order, and the Regular Research Table (research 1) comes first. The fifth is the Teak Research Table, which needs Homesteading level 30.

steps.text: Buy the @item{Regular Research Table} at level 1: 5,000 Logs and 2,000 Parsnip.
Buy the @item{Imbued Research Table} at level 5: 15,000 Imbued Fibers and 2,000 Potato.
Buy the @item{Oak Research Table} at level 10: 7,500 Oak Logs and 2,000 Radish.
Buy the @item{Willow Research Table} at level 20: 10,000 Willow Logs and 2,000 Wheat.
Buy the @item{Teak Research Table} at level 30: 12,500 Teak Logs and 2,000 Cauliflower.

achievements.description: Upgrade 10 Seed Research Table
achievements.summary: Research 10 upgrades at the Seed Research Table.

guide.context: Research must be bought in order, so the first five (Regular, Imbued, Oak, Willow and Teak) must already be bought. The tenth is the Yew Research Table, which needs Homesteading level 70.

steps.text: Buy the @item{Maple Research Table} at level 40: 15,000 Maple Logs and 2,000 Cabbage.
Buy the @item{Acadia Research Table} at level 50: 17,500 Acadia Logs and 2,000 Kale.
Buy the @item{Eucalyptus Research Table} at level 58: 20,000 Eucalyptus Logs and 2,000 Green Bean.
Buy the @item{Rubra Research Table} at level 65: 22,500 Rubra Logs and 2,000 Strawberry.
Buy the @item{Yew Research Table} at level 70: 25,000 Yew Logs and 2,000 Corn.

achievements.description: Purchase 1 Decorative Workbench
achievements.summary: Purchase 1 Decorative Workbench.

steps.text: Purchase one Decorative Workbench. The Decorative Regular Workbench costs 5,000 Logs.

achievements.description: Purchase 5 Decorative Workbench
achievements.summary: Purchase 5 Decorative Workbenches.

steps.text: Purchase five Decorative Workbenches. Costs: Regular 5,000 Logs, Oak 7,500 Oak Logs, Willow 10,000 Willow Logs, Teak 12,500 Teak Logs, Maple 15,000 Maple Logs.

achievements.description: Purchase 10 Decorative Workbench
achievements.summary: Purchase 10 Decorative Workbenches.

steps.text: Purchase ten Decorative Workbenches. Costs: Regular 5,000 Logs, Oak 7,500 Oak Logs, Willow 10,000 Willow Logs, Teak 12,500 Teak Logs, Maple 15,000 Maple Logs, Acadia 17,500 Acadia Logs, Eucalyptus 20,000 Eucalyptus Logs, Rubra 22,500 Rubra Logs, Yew 25,000 Yew Logs, Magic 30,000 Magic Logs.

achievements.description: Buy 1 Ore Decoration
achievements.summary: Unlock 1 ore decoration on the Homestead.

guide.context: Mining drops geodes at a base 1% chance for 1-2 geodes per attempt, and each unlock costs 50 geodes.

steps.text: Mine ore until you hold 50 geodes.
Walk through the green portal east of Ned's Rods in Havenport to reach the Homestead.
Customise an ore on the Homestead and unlock a decoration for it.

achievements.description: Buy 5 Ore Decoration
achievements.summary: Unlock 5 ore decorations on the Homestead.

guide.context: Mining drops geodes at a base 1% chance for 1-2 geodes per attempt, and each unlock costs 50 geodes.

steps.text: Mine ore until you hold 250 geodes (50 for each of the 5 decorations).
Walk through the green portal east of Ned's Rods in Havenport to reach the Homestead.
Customise ores on the Homestead and unlock decorations until you own 5.

achievements.description: Buy 10 Ore Decoration
achievements.summary: Unlock 10 ore decorations on the Homestead.

guide.context: Mining drops geodes at a base 1% chance for 1-2 geodes per attempt, and each unlock costs 50 geodes.

steps.text: Mine ore until you hold 500 geodes (50 for each of the 10 decorations).
Walk through the green portal east of Ned's Rods in Havenport to reach the Homestead.
Customise ores on the Homestead and unlock decorations until you own 10.

achievements.description: Buy 1 Tree Decoration
achievements.summary: Unlock 1 tree decoration on the Homestead.

guide.context: Woodcutting drops tree seeds at a base 1% chance for 1-2 seeds per attempt, and each unlock costs 50 seeds.

steps.text: Chop trees until you hold 50 tree seeds.
Walk through the green portal east of Ned's Rods in Havenport to reach the Homestead.
Customise a tree on the Homestead and unlock a decoration for it.

achievements.description: Buy 5 Tree Decorations
achievements.summary: Unlock 5 tree decorations on the Homestead.

guide.context: Woodcutting drops tree seeds at a base 1% chance for 1-2 seeds per attempt, and each unlock costs 50 seeds.

steps.text: Chop trees until you hold 250 tree seeds (50 for each of the 5 decorations).
Walk through the green portal east of Ned's Rods in Havenport to reach the Homestead.
Customise trees on the Homestead and unlock decorations until you own 5.

achievements.description: Buy 10 Tree Decorations
achievements.summary: Unlock 10 tree decorations on the Homestead.

guide.context: Woodcutting drops tree seeds at a base 1% chance for 1-2 seeds per attempt, and each unlock costs 50 seeds.

steps.text: Chop trees until you hold 500 tree seeds (50 for each of the 10 decorations).
Walk through the green portal east of Ned's Rods in Havenport to reach the Homestead.
Customise trees on the Homestead and unlock decorations until you own 10.

achievements.description: Every crop has a beginning, and so does knowledge.
achievements.summary: Reach the first Star Rank harvest total in the Farmer's Almanac for 1 crop.

guide.context: A crop counts once its total harvest reaches its target. Thieving crops are cheapest at 6,000 harvests. Foraging crops need 105,000. Woodcutting, Mining and Fishing crops need 25,000. Ranch crops need 600 grown.

steps.text: Steal from Thieving targets to collect crop seeds. Villagers give Parsnip, Potato and Radish Seeds.
Grow the seeds at the Homestead Workbench Crops plot and harvest them again and again.
Check each crop's total in the @mechanic{Farmer's Almanac} in the @mechanic{Codex}.

achievements.description: Patterns emerge in soil and seed.
achievements.summary: Reach the first Star Rank harvest total in the Farmer's Almanac for 5 different crops.

guide.context: A crop counts once its total harvest reaches its target. Thieving crops are cheapest at 6,000 harvests. Foraging crops need 105,000. Woodcutting, Mining and Fishing crops need 25,000. Ranch crops need 600 grown.

steps.text: Steal from Villagers (Parsnip, Potato, Radish Seeds) and Dock Workers (Wheat, Cauliflower, Cabbage Seeds), plus other Thieving targets as needed. Each crop needs its own Thieving level.
Grow the seeds at the Homestead Workbench Crops plot and harvest them again and again.
Move crop by crop through the @mechanic{Farmer's Almanac} until 5 crops reach their targets.

achievements.description: Ten harvests, ten stories inked into time.
achievements.summary: Reach the first Star Rank harvest total in the Farmer's Almanac for 10 different crops.

guide.context: A crop counts once its total harvest reaches its target. Thieving crops are cheapest at 6,000 harvests. Foraging crops need 105,000. Woodcutting, Mining and Fishing crops need 25,000. Ranch crops need 600 grown.

steps.text: Steal seeds for 10 Thieving crops: from Villagers Parsnip (Thieving level 1), Potato (10) and Radish (20); from Dock Workers Wheat (30), Cauliflower (40) and Cabbage (50); from Herbalists Kale (60) and Green Bean (70); from Fishers Strawberry (80) and Corn (90).
Grow the seeds at the Homestead Workbench Crops plot and harvest them again and again.
Move crop by crop through the @mechanic{Farmer's Almanac} until 10 crops reach their targets.

achievements.description: You read the land like others read a book.
achievements.summary: Reach the first Star Rank harvest total in the Farmer's Almanac for 20 different crops.

guide.context: A crop counts once its total harvest reaches its target. Thieving crops are cheapest at 6,000 harvests. Foraging crops need 105,000. Woodcutting, Mining and Fishing crops need 25,000. Ranch crops need 600 grown.

steps.text: Steal seeds from Thieving targets until you have grown 20 of the 21 Thieving crops, from Parsnip at Thieving level 1 up to Red Cabbage from the Treasure Hunter at level 280, depending on which 20 you pick.
Grow the seeds at the Homestead Workbench Crops plot and harvest them again and again.
